title: Radius of circular path
description: Essential: Correctly states or derives the radius formula R = sqrt(2mqU) / (qB).

title: Distance L from geometry
description: Important: Correctly applies geometry (cos α = sqrt(R²-d²)/R) to find L = R - sqrt(R² - d²).

title: Impact x-coordinate derivation
description: Important: Correctly calculates the x-displacement in region II using kinematics under electric force.

title: Impact y-coordinate derivation
description: Important: Correctly combines magnetic arc deflection (L) and electric field drift (y') to find total y.

title: Particle identification
description: Essential: Correctly matches s1, s2, s3 to triton, helium, proton based on mass/charge ratio effects on R and deflection.

title: Velocity from energy conservation
description: Important: Uses work-energy theorem (qU = 1/2 mv²) to find speed before magnetic field.

title: Force laws application
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law for magnetic (qvB = mv²/R) and electric (qE = ma) forces.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Misidentifies the direction of deflection in x or y, or misapplies coordinate axes.

title: Algebraic simplification error
description: Pitfall: Makes algebraic mistakes in combining kinematic and geometric relations for L, x, or y.
